title.zh: 公共赌馆（豁免）（第 5 号）公告 2009
title.vi: Thông báo Nhà cái cờ bạc công cộng (Miễn trừ) (Số 5) 2009
title.th: ประกาศบ่อนการพนันทั่วไป (การยกเว้น) (ฉบับที่ 5) 2009

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Common Gaming Houses (Exemption) (No. 5) Notification 2009.

2.—(1) The Minister hereby exempts the Singapore Pools (Private) Limited from the provisions of the Act in respect of the promotion, organisation, administration or operation of any gaming done in connection with the Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile Formula One World Championship.
(2) The exemption is subject to compliance by the Singapore Pools (Private) Limited with the conditions stated in the letter of approval dated 27th February 2009.
